description: Defines a DateTimeModel class in the OrangeHRM Attendance Plugin API, which serializes DateTime objects into a structured array with date and time properties.

classes.name: DateTimeModel
classes.description: A model class representing date and time information, serializable to an array with UTC date and time properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a DateTime object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the DateTime into an array with 'utcDate' and 'utcTime' fields.
